basic_profile.bio: Avid Guild Wars 2 player from Halifax who loves delving into the intricacies of the game's economy. I spend most of my online time in the evenings after work, as I'm a part-time IT technician at a local firm. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy following the latest updates on COVID-19 vaccines and reading about retro video games like those in the Rance series. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring new hobbies like hiking and photography.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in information technology, having studied computer science in college. I also have extensive knowledge of MMORPGs like Guild Wars 2, gained through years of gameplay and active participation in related online forums and communities. My interest in health topics has grown due to the pandemic, leading me to frequent subreddits focused on COVID-19 vaccines.
